system.description:
Wondrous Item, Rare

This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast Dimension Door as a Magic action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is LightlyObscured by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

notes: not automated (teleport): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
